title: post-stamped --comment: refuse a decision analysis that carries no os-decision-facets marker
body:
Fixes #23420

Clause-②: no

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么:** 席位用 `post-stamped.mjs --comment` 往卡上发评论时,如果这条评论是一份「决策分析」——标题或开头点明待您裁的决定、摆出几个选项、并推荐其中一项——却没带四棱块的机器标记 `os-decision-facets`,工具现在当场拒写,不发出去,并告诉作者补上四棱块的固定格式。卡片正文和其它写入方式不受影响。

**为什么改:** 收班前检查只认这个标记来找「还在等您裁的决定」。上一班有两份分析没带标记,检查就看不见它们,这两个决定于是被漏在您的收件箱外。检查本身没问题,缺的是写的那一刻没拦住。

**风险与代价(含回滚):** 风险是误拦——席位一次正常的写入被退回,要改了再发。用近 5.5 天全部 5,519 条车队评论回放:只拦下 8 条,全是缺标记的决策分析(点名的两份都在内);总监的增量意见、分诊轮报、认领、落地记录、开发报告、契约评审,一条都没拦。代价是漏网:开头不用决策词的分析(比如以「维护者速读」开头的)认不出来,照旧写入——宁可漏,不误拦。回滚 = 撤回本 PR,只动一个文件。

**席位意见:**

**你要做的:** 无。本 PR 不碰受治理面,走普通落地路径。

## What changes

`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` gains one write-side refusal, `[decision-facets]`, on `--comment` only, beside the claim and record keyed-line refusals and before any request (so `--dry-run` is refused exactly as a live write is). `--body` and every other route are untouched. `references/decision-analysis.md`, `SKILL.md`, `.github/**` and every other `scripts/pm` file are unchanged (`decision-analysis.md` net-zero: no twin had to move).

## The predicate

A comment is a **decision analysis** when all three signals hold, read over the body with fenced and inline code blanked (`stripMarkdownCode`):

- **FRAME** — its opening line, a heading, or a bold lead (a paragraph or list item opening with a bold span) opens, decoration skipped, with one of `DECISION_FRAME_OPENERS`: 决策 · 待裁 · 待维护者裁决 · 回箱待裁 · 决裁 · 重新分析 · 席位意见 · Seat reading · Decision · Re-analysis · Needs the maintainer's word (each frozen beside the live heading it was measured on). Opening, not containing: `## Triage: decision-box entry check` is a triage record.
- **OPTIONS** — inside the span that frame governs (a heading's section down to the next heading of its level or above; a bold lead's down to the next heading; a plain opening line's the whole body): a table whose header row has an option column (选项 / 方案 / Option), or two or more distinct option labels (A to F, optional digit or prime: `A`, `B2`, `C′`) as the bold lead of an **unindented** list item, the bold holding the label and at most a parenthetical and a colon.
- **RECOMMENDATION** — in the same span: 推荐 (not 不推荐), `recommend` / `recommends` or `recommendation`, followed by an option label (a question prefix such as `Q1 =` / 问一, or a card number, may sit between).

It is refused when it carries no `os-decision-facets` outside code: `hasDecisionFacetMarker(stripMarkdownCode(body))`, the very composition `check-handover.mjs` calls `carriesFacetMarker`, so the write side refuses exactly what the handover reader would miss. Both the token and its reader are **imported from `check-half-states.mjs`**, which owns them and which `post-stamped.mjs` already imported from; `check-handover.mjs` itself is not imported, because it imports `seatPostVacancy` from `post-stamped.mjs` and the import back would be a cycle. A self-test case pins `check-handover.mjs`'s `carriesFacetMarker` to the same composition, so a change on either side reds here.

**Why three signals and not two** (the suggested shape was a decision heading AND an options table or a 推荐 line): measured over the same stream, FRAME AND (table OR recommendation) refuses **45** comments — 7 true analyses, 1 director filing, and 37 false refusals: 10 director delta readings (`## 席位意见（增量）` / `## 席位意见 · director seat`, each backing a letter with 推荐), 22 triage round records on the seat post (`### Decision box` with `recommends X` digests), 4 summon ledgers and 1 seat note. A delta backs a letter and never lays the options out again; a round record nests each card's options under that card's bullet, or puts them in another section. The OPTIONS conditions (a laid-out set, unindented, inside the frame's span) are exactly what separates those. (The 45 was read with a scratch prototype using whole-body signals; every other number below is the shipped function at this branch's head.)

## Measured hit/miss table

**Corpus A — the repository comment stream**: 5,519 `objectstack-fleet[bot]` comments on objectstack-ai/objectstack, 2026-10-08T23:36Z to 2026-10-14T10:29Z (REST `GET /repos/{repo}/issues/comments?sort=created&direction=desc`, 60 pages, read once at ~10:30Z), replayed through the shipped `decisionFacetRefusals` at `6a5ae14ef6`.

| Population | n | refused | passes | reading |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| Named must-refuse: 6141962120 (#23193), 6147446653 (#23169) | 2 | **2** | 0 | hit — FRAME `Needs the maintainer's word` + labels A/B/C + `recommends **A**`; FRAME `## 决策:` + 选项 table + `推荐 A` |
| Named must-pass: 6164664770 (#23431, HTML-comment marker) | 1 | 0 | **1** | recognised as an analysis; carries the marker |
| Director delta readings (`## 席位意见…· director seat`, summon #37) | 12 | 0 | **12** | none lays options out; ⚠️ none carries the marker outside code (6161223570 quotes it in inline code) |
| Director decision filing 6164270805 (#23432, `Release:` + `## 席位意见（增量）`) | 1 | **1** | 0 | options A/B/C laid out + `推荐 A`, no marker, and no analysis carrying the block anywhere on that card — see Acceptance notes |
| Other analyses without the marker | 5 | **5** | 0 | 6138951701 (#23176), 6092351336 (#22507), 6082946866 (#22075), 6082144903 and 6075765435 (#16468) |
| Analyses without the marker **missed** | 2 | 0 | 2 | 6073910758 (#22407, opens `## 维护者速读`), 6111357879 (#22865, opens `## 补充子问题`, options in prose leads) |
| Marker carriers (outside code) | 35 | 0 | 35 | 25 recognised as analyses; 10 not (3 `Ruling:` records, 7 `## Triage:` records) — they pass either way |
| `## 席位核对` records on PRs #23435 / #23439 / #23450 | 3 | 0 | 3 | untouched |
| `## Contract review` records on the same three PRs | 3 | 0 | 3 | untouched |
| Every comment on #23377 / #23409 / #23423 (claims, `os-dev-report`s, ACCEPT pointers, landings, triage grades) | 16 | 0 | 16 | untouched |
| **All fleet-bot comments** | **5,519** | **8** | **5,511** | precision 8/8 on reading each refusal; recall on markerless analyses 8/10 |

**Corpus B — the card's literal corpus**: comments on every item labelled `needs-user-decision` today, in either state (17 issues and 121 PRs): **36** fleet-bot comments (2026-09-23 to 2026-10-14), fewer than the 200 the card names; 1 analysis (6164664770, carries the marker) passes, **0 refused**. Over every author on those items (258 comments, 2026-08-03 to 2026-10-14): 0 refused. The corpus is thin by construction: a decision card's `needs-user-decision` is replaced at its ruling, so a label filter reads today's inbox, not the decision history — #23193 and #23169 are not in it, which is why Corpus A carries the measurement.

## The refusal, as printed

Replay of 6141962120 (its opening stamp tokenised as the act's clock, its body stamps declared as readings) through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --dry-run --comment=23420 --file=…`, exit 2:

```text
post-stamped: REFUSED — this comment is a decision analysis and carries no `os-decision-facets` marker outside code. Nothing was written.
  1. [decision-facets] frame:          Needs the maintainer's word.
      options:        option labels `A`, `B`, `C` as list-item leads
      recommendation: recommends A

  A decision analysis anchored on its card carries the four-facet block, and the block's first line is the
  machine-findable marker: append it — `os-decision-facets` alone on a line (or its HTML-comment form), then the four
  facets ① 项目长远合理性 ② 实际业务拉动 ③ 防 AI 犯错 ④ 创业阶段不扩散, one line each, and the `Prior rulings read:` line.
  The shape is `references/decision-analysis.md` 〈四棱卡面块固定形状〉. The pre-handover check finds a pending
  decision by that marker alone, so an analysis without it leaves the decision outside the maintainer's inbox.
  A marker inside code is a quotation and clears nothing. ⛔ No flag turns it off.
```

CLI replays (`--dry-run`, offline core): `--comment` on 6141962120 and 6147446653 exit **2**; `--comment` on 6164664770 exit **0**; `--body` on 6141962120 and 6147446653 exit **0** (the refusal is `--comment`'s).

## Self-test

`node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --self-test` exit **0**: `✓ post-stamped self-test: 679 cases pass across 24 batteries`. New battery `the decision facets: a decision analysis carries its marker, and a delta, a record or a quotation is not one`, 22 cases, floor 22:

- **Refused:** THE MEASURED CHINESE ANALYSIS (heading frame, options table, `推荐` line) without the marker is REFUSED, one row · THE MEASURED ENGLISH ANALYSIS (bold-lead frame, lettered items, `recommends **A**`) without the marker is REFUSED · a marker inside code is a QUOTATION and clears nothing.
- **Accepted:** the same two analyses with the four-facet block appended are ACCEPTED · the HTML-comment form of the marker reads the same.
- **Non-analysis untouched:** a director DELTA reading · a round record (three signals in three sections; the same lines in one section ARE an analysis) · a triage record under `## Triage:` (the stated recall limit) · two signals are not an analysis (three pairings) · an article, a hypothesis and a finding list are not option labels · an indented item and `不推荐` · `recommends a fix` and `recommended **B**` · a claim, a fenced `os-dev-report`, a `## Contract review` record.
- **Reading and text:** question prefixes and card numbers between 推荐 and its letter · the frame through emphasis, both languages, any heading level or the opening line · the refusal names marker, row, remedy and shape · the refusal carries no tracker number and no HTML comment · the openers frozen with their measured lines, no `g` cursor.
- **Structural:** runs on `--comment` only, before the transport · token and reader imported from their owner, never restated · `check-handover.mjs`'s `carriesFacetMarker` is the same composition.

## Gates (local, on `6a5ae14ef6`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived **31** commands for the one path; all 31 run, each **exit 0** captured before any pipe (`pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: fast tier 1841 cases pass; `pnpm check:pm-post-stamped`: 679 cases).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.list`: exit **0** — 31 derived, 31 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `pnpm -s check:pm-skill-ratchet`: exit **0** (no skill file touched).
- Outside the derivation: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` exit **0**; `node scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs --self-test` exit **0** (the importer of `seatPostVacancy`: 46 cases).
- CI families (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard and the rest) are read off this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

## Acceptance notes

- **6164270805 is refused, and that is read as correct.** The dispatch expected the director's delta readings to carry the facet block and pass; measured, **none** of the 12 carries it outside code, and all 12 pass because none lays options out (the decision-analysis shape: the director's pre-batch card comment is a delta, the facet block is the filing's). 6164270805 is different in kind: it moved #23432 into the decision box with options A/B/C laid out and 推荐 A, and nothing on that card carried the block — it was the filing, so the handover check could not have found it. If the director seat reads it as a delta that should pass, the narrowest change is an exemption keyed on 增量 in the frame, at the cost of a spelling any author can type to step around the refusal.
- **Recall limits, by design (precision before recall):** an analysis whose frame does not open with a decision word (`## 维护者速读…`, `## 补充子问题…`), whose options are prose leads (`**A 等…**`), or that recommends without naming a label, is written as before; the two such analyses in the window are listed above. A triage record that files a decision box is not recognised (7 in the window, all carrying the marker).
- **Not read:** the target's number — the core stays offline, so whether a comment lands on the decision's own card is the writer's half. Old analyses are not re-read (the card's out-of-scope; the 6 historical markerless analyses above stay as they are).
- No out-of-scope finding meets the filing bar.
